g.text: Optocoupler wired-OR: LOW = recent audio. 103ms nominal release RC.

g.desc: Optocoupler wired-OR: LOW = recent audio. 103ms nominal release RC.

g.text: Firmware must require 500ms persistence, then time 10min silence.

g.desc: Firmware must require 500ms persistence, then time 10min silence.

g.text: Blank detection at startup, source changes and after power-off.

g.desc: Blank detection at startup, source changes and after power-off.

g.text: Do not count a single edge/click as continuous audio.

g.desc: Do not count a single edge/click as continuous audio.

g.text: Driver inputs tied low when MCU is reset.

g.desc: Driver inputs tied low when MCU is reset.

g.text: Unused ULN inputs grounded; outputs genuinely unused.

g.desc: Unused ULN inputs grounded; outputs genuinely unused.

g.text: J8 pin 1 UPDI; pin 2 target-voltage reference; pin 3 GND.

g.desc: J8 pin 1 UPDI; pin 2 target-voltage reference; pin 3 GND.

g.text: Programmer must not back-power the board. BOD 4.2V + watchdog in firmware.

g.desc: Programmer must not back-power the board. BOD 4.2V + watchdog in firmware.

g.text: SOURCE_AV high: Marantz, relay ON, protected 12V at J13.1.

g.desc: SOURCE_AV high: Marantz, relay ON, protected 12V at J13.1.

g.text: Low/reset/unpowered: preamp, relay OFF, trigger disconnected.

g.desc: Low/reset/unpowered: preamp, relay OFF, trigger disconnected.

g.text: J13.2 = control GND; connect only to sub J20.2 trigger return.

g.desc: J13.2 = control GND; connect only to sub J20.2 trigger return.

g.text: Sub J20.1 = positive; onboard 2k2/opto draws about 5mA.

g.desc: Sub J20.1 = positive; onboard 2k2/opto draws about 5mA.

g.text: Isolation is at sub optocoupler; do not link to sub audio GND.

g.desc: Isolation is at sub optocoupler; do not link to sub audio GND.

g.text: G7L-2A-T DC12: J10 pin 1 coil+; pin 2 low-side.

g.desc: G7L-2A-T DC12: J10 pin 1 coil+; pin 2 low-side.

g.text: They do not verify relay contacts.

g.desc: They do not verify relay contacts.
